batch.description: Jahangirnagar University H Unit (Institute of Information Technology), academic session 2019-2020, Set-E — full 80-question paper transcribed by direct visual reading (with zoomed crops) of Part 2 of the Udvash 'জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক' (JU A & D Unit question bank), book PDF pp.245-252 (printed pp.60-67 of Part 2). Part 2 has NO answer table: each question carries its key inline, as an '[Ans: x]' tag and/or a printed worked solution ('সমাধান:'/'Solution:'); the two forms never occur together for the same question in this paper, so no tag-vs-solution disagreement exists. EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions are marked content-UNVERIFIED and all keyed answers answer-UNVERIFIED — the printed publisher answer keys are preserved as-is and are NOT official JU keys; cross-source verification is a later stage. The paper is printed in two syllabus tiers whose question numbers interlock: the 'Short Syllabus' run (banner on book PDF p.245) carries 63 questions and the 'Extra Syllabus' block (heading on book PDF p.251, continuing on p.252) carries the remaining 17 (Q28, 29, 30, 33, 41, 50, 53, 54, 55, 56, 57, 64, 65, 66, 76, 77, 80); together they partition the printed numbers 1-80 exactly once, and each question's tier is recorded in its topic field. No 'Old Syllabus' block occurs in this paper. The book prints no per-subject headings; subject blocks follow the printed question-number ranges, confirmed by content: Bangla Q1-5, English Q6-20, Higher Mathematics Q21-60, Physics Q61-80 — counts Bangla 5, English 15, Higher Mathematics 40, Physics 20. Question numbers are NOT printed in numeric order across the pages: p.245 carries Q1-15; p.246 carries Q16-24; p.247 carries Q25-27, 31, 32, 34, 35; p.248 carries Q36-40, 42-45; p.249 carries Q46-49, 51, 52, 58, 59; p.250 carries Q60-63, 67-72; p.251 carries Q73-75, 78, 79 and (Extra Syllabus) Q28-30, 33, 41; p.252 carries (Extra Syllabus) Q50, 53-57, 64-66, 76, 77, 80, ending with Q80. Keys: 77 keyed single_choice, 0 dual keys, 1 keyless (Q16, which prints a '[No Ans:]' marker and no solution), and exactly TWO printed no-correct-option dispositions — Q30 (Extra Syllabus, printed solution headed 'সমাধান: (No answer)') and Q38 (printed solution headed 'সমাধান: (সঠিক উত্তর নেই)'); those two carry answerDisposition 'no_correct_option' with correctOptionIds [] and answerVerificationStatus 'verified' solely because the validator requires that status for a no_correct_option disposition — it records the book's own printed claim (the printed solution's no-answer statement), not cross-source verification — while their contentVerificationStatus remains 'unverified' like every other question in this extraction-stage pack. No question in this paper carries a figure or diagram of its own; small diagrams appear only inside the printed worked solutions of Q25, Q28, Q45 and Q46. Preserved print anomalies: Q15(d) prints 'Sheepss' with a capital S; Q29's stem prints the word as 'INSITUTE' (missing the second T); Q27(a) prints 'বৃত্ত' for বৃত্তটি; Q30's options (a)-(c) are printed in the variable y although the stem asks for f^-1(x); Q40(a) prints '-1 ≥ x'; Q50's stem prints the second and third direction angles identically (both cos^-1(-1/√6)) and its options name the vector Q→ in (a)/(d) but P→ in (b)/(c); Q57's printed solution keys (d) while stating the year 1939, which is not among options (a)-(c); Q62 prints the unit as 'kmhr^-1' throughout; Q64 prints the units 'TmA^-1' and 'Am^-1'; Q71's stem prints P and Q with no vector arrow and the third component as a plain 'k' with no hat; Q75(c) prints 'v = aj/(ne)' and Q75(d) prints 'v = ej/n'; Q77(a) prints the unit 'ms^3' and Q77(c) prints 'ms^4' for a velocity, and its stem prints '5T' with no space. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.notes: Publisher question-bank book (Udvash Academic & Admission Care), scanned PDF, 295 pp. The book's Part 2 (typeset প্রশ্ন-সমাধান section, banner 'প্রশ্ন ও সমাধান: ২০১৯-২০') restarts pagination: printed page = book PDF page - 185. Set-E of JU H Unit 2019-2020 occupies printed pp.60-67 = book PDF pp.245-252: 'Short Syllabus' run on pp.245-251 (banner on p.245) and the 'Extra Syllabus' block beginning on printed p.66 (book PDF p.251) and continuing on printed p.67 (book PDF p.252). There is no answer table in Part 2; keys are inline ('[Ans: x]' tags and printed 'সমাধান:'/'Solution:' worked solutions printed directly under each question, plus one '[No Ans:]' marker at Q16). Paper header (book PDF p.245) confirmed before transcription: জাবি ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১৯-২০২০ শিক্ষাবর্ষ, পূর্ণমান: ৮০, ইউনিট-H, সেট-E, সময়: ১:০০ ঘণ্টা. The preceding paper (H Unit 2020-2021 Set-A) ends before p.245 and the following paper, H Unit 2018-2019 Set-A, begins on printed p.68 (book PDF p.253); nothing outside pp.245-252 is included. Transcription by direct visual reading of the 300-dpi page renders, with zoomed re-reads (PIL half-page crops) of every page. Mathematical notation linearised (^ for superscripts, a/b for fractions, √, π, matrices wrapped in [...] with rows separated by ';', unit vectors as î, ĵ, k̂ and vector arrows as →; Bangla numerals in numeric contexts converted to Western digits).
